name: sa-docgen
description: Solution Architecture Word (.docx) and PDF Document Generator
//optionalDependencies: pdfmake backs the PDF path only. generate-doc.js requires render-pdf.js lazily, inside the `format === 'pdf'` branch, so an install without pdfmake keeps a fully working Word path and fails with a clear message only if --format pdf is asked for. Listing it as a plain dependency made that defensive code unreachable through the documented install.
//mermaid: @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli is an optionalDependency, not a plain one: it pulls Puppeteer, and a machine that cannot build it must still get a working Word path. `bun install` at the repo root puts the mmdc shim in node_modules/.bin, where render-mermaid.js finds it with no configuration. Bun does NOT run Puppeteer's post-install browser download, so a browser is the remaining piece — `bun scripts/setup-docgen.ts` reports both and prints what to do. Without mmdc every Mermaid block still exports, as monospace source.
